sentences.text: When the matter was taken up for Final Hearing, it is noticed that, as per the order dated 07.08.2015, the appeal was dismissed as against respondent No.2/Insurance Company without reference to the Court.
Thereafter, no steps have been taken against respondent No.2 since no application was filed to recalling the said order.
2. The appellant challenging the liability fastened against him.
It is argued that the driver of the autorickshaw was holding an effective driving license at the time of the accident.
Since the appeal itself was dismissed against respondent No.2 as per the order dated 07.08.2015, the appeal does not survive for consideration.
3. Accordingly, the appeal is dismissed as having become infructuous.
